title: Chapter 402 Call For Help
content:
Chapter 402 Call For Help

As he said that, the man shouted at the old man beside him, "Old Wu, call me!"

After pondering for a moment, the old man named Wu also took out a simple jade slip with the word Wu engraved on it, and then he was about to crush the jade slip.

But at this time, Lu Xue spoke out and stopped him, "Wait a minute!"

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Mr. Wu stopped and looked at Lu Xue in confusion.

Could it be that the other party is afraid?

It shouldn't be, the other party's background shouldn't be low, so you won't admit defeat so quickly.

People like them who only rely on their background usually don’t cry when they see the coffin, and he still has a clear understanding of himself and others.

The man beside him also thought Lu Xue was afraid, so he immediately became arrogant again. Before Lu Xue could speak, he smiled evilly and hooked up at Lu Xue, arrogantly raising his hands at Lu Xue, He said, "Woman, come here now and serve me comfortably. I may consider letting you go, otherwise, hum."

"When the people of my family come, you will definitely be worse than death!"

At this moment, the scene fell into ghostly silence again.

For some reason, Mr. Wu next to the man suddenly had an ominous premonition.

Lu Xue and others, the old man Broken Sword covered his face with helplessness. Ao Qing in the sky was stunned for a moment, and then he was furious. Even Lu Xue, who had not had any emotions, had a gloomy face at this moment.

The man was already like a dead person in the eyes of Lu Xue and others.

Lu Xue's palm spread out, and a sword light emitting strong cold gradually condensed. In just a moment, the surrounding temperature dropped sharply, and everyone felt as if they were in an extremely cold place.

call out!

The sword light flashed, and then the man's face suddenly changed drastically. He collapsed to the ground with a plop, and started to wail with his knees.

"Ah!! My legs, my legs!!!"

A shocking blood hole appeared on the man's knee, and then a terrifying chill began to spread along the blood hole.

His legs are ruined and he is likely to not get better in his life.

"master!"

The sudden change made Old Wu look frightened. He hurriedly stepped forward to check the injuries. Seeing the injuries on his master's leg, even he couldn't help but take a breath. Such a method was definitely not an ordinary person.

Yes, how could a person who could make such a terrifying dragon willingly surrender would be an ordinary person?

This time, they hit the nail on the head.

"Call me, I'll call you."

At this time, Lu Xue in the distance suddenly said coldly.

Hearing this, Old Wu looked ugly. The jade slip in his hand was already covered with sweat, but he did not dare to crush it.

The man reacted from the severe pain. He looked pale and grabbed Mr. Wu's collar and said angrily: "Why are you still standing there? I want to make them live worse than death!"

As soon as these words were said, Mr. Wu knew that this was no longer something they could decide.

If he calls someone and the other party is really a stern person, he will definitely be useless, but if he doesn't call someone, he will definitely die here.

Thinking of this, Mr. Wu no longer hesitated.

There was a click.

The jade slip is broken.

The surrounding space suddenly began to fluctuate wildly, sending a distress signal to the forces. It won’t take long before a strong person breaks through the space.

Seeing the other party crushing the jade slip for help, Lu Xue and others looked at them quietly as if nothing had happened.

The more this happens, the more desperate Mr. Wu feels.

He even felt like he wanted to surrender and beg for mercy at this moment, but his long-term sense of superiority made him unable to do so. Of course, there was still no exact threat of life. If the other party put a knife on his neck, he would have been the first time. I'm afraid I have to follow my heart than anyone else.

The man next to him had a distorted expression. At this moment, he not only had to bear the severe pain from his legs, but also looked at the arrogant gaze of Lu Xue and others, how could he bear it?

At this time, Ao Qing had also shrunk his body and returned to Lu Xue's shoulders.

"My little master, they have already called people, why not kill them directly?"

Ao Qing glanced at the old and young people in the distance and said casually.

This sentence made the old man Duanjian twitch. After so many years, Ao Qing still hasn't changed at all.

It's just that no one takes it seriously.

He has been in the foreign affairs for many years, so now he has become very cautious. Basically, if he can't make enemies, he will not choose to be enemies with the other party, and big things will turn into small things.

If there are conflicts that can be resolved, it is better to solve them with one more friend than to have one more enemy.

But he has no choice but to be an extremely arrogant playboy like the other side, and he usually doesn't mess with him.

At this moment, he was thinking, if Lu Xue and Ao Qing were not there at this time, then how would he solve it?

How to kill the other party simply and face endless pursuit?

The old man Broken Sword shook his head. He was old. Although he had been wandering around for the rest of his life, he seemed to have exhausted his energy and returned to his former world of heaven and mysteriousness.

He can no longer be as energetic and reckless as he was when he was young.

Now, what he thinks of is living.

Thinking of this, the old man Broken Sword looked down at the broken sword in his hand. Perhaps, now he is like this broken sword, no longer has the sharpness he used to be.

"What's the hurry? Life and death are just a matter of my thoughts. Now, I want to know more about who the power behind the other party will be?"

Lu Xue's tone was calm and she didn't take the other person seriously at all.

Now she was guessing in her heart whether it would be a person from Huangcheng.

The deserted city is developing rapidly now, and any one inside is probably a well-known figure on the outside.

However, Lu Xue had made up her mind that she would punish her severely even if the other party was someone she knew behind her and would never show any mercy.

This time I met her. If she was really a little girl with no background and strength, wouldn’t she really be ruthlessly ruined by the other party?

And everyone's waiting did not last long.

After a moment, the space in the field began to fluctuate again.

Immediately afterwards, a majestic scolding sounded from the field, causing a stir.

"Who dares to be disrespectful to my Wu family and live impatiently?!"

Buzz —

A huge space teleportation channel appeared in front of everyone, and then a middle-aged man in martial uniform and bandages appeared on the field.

I saw him still left and right, and at first glance he saw the man who collapsed on the ground, almost fainting in pain.

"Wu Hua!"

The middle-aged man rushed to Wu Hua's side immediately. When he saw the injury on Wu Hua's leg, he couldn't help but his eyelids twitched wildly.

This method,

"Who is it, who did it!?"

A raging arose suddenly burned from his chest.
